t: What Does The Name Onner Mean?
s: It is often analyzed as a regional or phonetic variant of Honor/Honour (from Latin honor, “esteem, reputation”), or of the Germanic compound names anchored in the element Ans-/Os- (“god, divine”), such as Anner, Omer, or the Scandinavian Onar/Onnir (Old Norse Ónarr/Onarr). In Icelandic, Onnir appears as a plural form tied to the mythic Ásynjur/Æsir contexts in some sources, while in Swedish and Norwegian records Onar/Onner can show up as archaic or dialectal spellings.
